title: passArrays
body:
## passArrays

Keeps only the named point, cell and field arrays of the input and removes every other array of those associations; geometry and topology are unchanged (shallow copy, so it is cheap). Use it to slim a dataset before export or publication, or to drop arrays that would confuse later steps. Each list has the Schemaxis default [], and an empty list keeps none of that association's arrays. Use pvPassArrays when vertex, edge or row (table) arrays also need selecting.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Listing only pointArrays removes every cell and field array, because the other lists default to []; list the arrays you need in each association.
- Names are matched exactly; a misspelt name keeps nothing and the array disappears.
- Ghost-cell arrays (vtkGhostType) are kept unless explicitly deselected.

Native constructor: `PassArrays`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pointArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}` | `[]` | `[]` |
| `cellArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}` | `[]` | `[]` |
| `fieldArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}` | `[]` | `[]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "passArrays",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
